acquisitionRules: No corpus source may be promoted without a provenance record.
Unknown or ambiguous licensing must be treated as review-required, not assumed usable.
Raw source artifacts must remain distinct from processed corpus artifacts.
Every corpus version used for tokenizer or model training must have a reproducible manifest.
Every manifest must record artifact hashes, byte counts and document counts.
Training and evaluation datasets must be logically separated.
Dataset acquisition must not modify D0.

contract.purpose: Define acquisition, provenance, licensing, quality and corpus-versioning requirements before D1 data collection.

exclusions: private or confidential material without authorization
malware payload corpora intended to teach harmful execution
unknown-license commercial books copied without permission
benchmark answer keys intentionally inserted for score inflation

languagePolicy.architectureRestriction: None. Byte-level representation must permit future multilingual expansion.
languagePolicy.rule: Do not claim multilingual capability merely because the tokenizer can encode UTF-8. Capability requires meaningful training data and evaluation.

prohibitions: do not download datasets during DATA-001
do not scrape arbitrary websites during DATA-001
do not train tokenizer during DATA-001
do not start D1 model training during DATA-001
do not create D1 model weights during DATA-001
do not silently accept unknown-license data
do not mix evaluation answers into training for score inflation

qualityPipeline.requirement: Preserve raw source separately from processed data.
SHA-256 hash every acquired raw artifact.
Validate text decoding and record failures.
Apply only documented, non-lossy or explicitly approved normalization.
Remove empty, corrupt and clearly unusable documents.
Perform exact duplicate detection and later near-duplicate analysis.
Measure language distribution rather than assuming it.
Establish evaluation-set contamination checks before model evaluation.
Seal processed corpus version with hashes and counts.

readinessGates.requirement: At least one approved source has complete provenance metadata.
Raw acquired artifacts are SHA-256 hashed.
Corpus reaches at least the 10 MB tokenizer development floor.
Tokenizer training corpus manifest is sealed before tokenizer training.

modelTrainingCorpus.reason: Final D1 model-training token budget must be selected using corpus quality, tokenizer statistics, compute throughput and measured MPS training cost.

sourceClasses.description: Public-domain text with verifiable source and jurisdiction/licensing metadata.
Text distributed under a license compatible with the intended Denarixx use.
Original material owned or created for Denarixx.
Government/public-sector text only after source-specific reuse terms are recorded.
Research datasets only after dataset-card, license and redistribution/training terms are reviewed.
Unfiltered web crawling is not automatically approved. Domain, rights, quality and privacy controls are required first.
